messages:
support_bot: New ticket TKT-9731 from ACME (enterprise). They want progressive UI: partial structured JSON frames streamed as tokens arrive, AND ability to trigger function/tool calls mid-generation (i.e., tool call can start before full completion). Link: https://redwood.support/t/9731

jordan_sales: +1 — this ties to their renewal. they asked for early access and would pay for a beta. :moneybag:

maya: Can we get impact numbers? how often do they do this? any sample transcripts or schema they'd want enforced?

support_bot: Pasting excerpt from ticket: 

"user: start chat -> model starts streaming some metadata
app: needs first chunk to render a table header
model: decides to call tool 'pricing_lookup' mid-turn -> returns rows -> app wants partial rows as they arrive"

samir: From runtime perspective we need to interleave three streams: token deltas, tool_call events, and structured-chunk events. Proposal: extend streaming protocol with envelope events. Minimal event set: token, tool_call_start, tool_call_output, tool_call_end, structured_chunk. Use ndjson-ish frames so SDKs can parse incrementally. Example event stream:```
event: tool_call_start {"tool":"pricing_lookup","call_id":"c1"}
event: tool_call_output {"call_id":"c1","chunk":"{\"rows\":[...]"}
event: tool_call_end {"call_id":"c1","status":"ok"}
event: structured_chunk {"path":"choices[0].delta","chunk":"{\"tableRows\": [...] }"}
event: token "\u003cpartial text\u003e"
```

alex: Key concerns: batching and KV cache. If we split a request into batches, we must preserve ordering for tool calls and resulting structured deltas. Also need backpressure behavior on tool latency.

maya: Product acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) Server can stream interleaved structured chunks + tool events reliably; 2) Backwards compatible for existing clients (default behavior unchanged); 3) SDKs provide parsing helpers; 4) Perf: p50 token latency regression <10% for hosted API; 5) Canary with ACME and test harness for data validation (schema enforcement). Also need security review for tool payloads.

samir: Rough estimate for minimal viable server + runtime + SDK support: 2 engineers 6 weeks + 1 infra sprint for canary infra. If we include multi-tool orchestration and at-least-once guarantees, add ~2 more weeks. Risks: increased tail latency, batching inefficiencies, SDK churn.

jordan_sales: If we can hit a 6-week canary, I can secure the early-access purchase. Put that in the note to prioritize.

maya: Decision: triage -> create epic "streaming-structured-tool-events". Priority: P0 for enterprise intake (ACME tied to contract). Owner: samir (eng), PM: maya. Next actions: 1) eng writes design doc w/ API proposal by EOD Fri, 2) support attaches 3 sample sessions + schema, 3) SDK owners scope parsing helpers, 4) infra schedules canary slots.

support_bot: TKT-9731 status updated: Triaged -> linked to epic streaming-structured-tool-events.

samir: Will open spec PR today and add a sketch of the ndjson envelope + semantics. I’ll paste link once created.

maya: Thanks all — keeping this scoped minimal for the canary. Follow-ups: add launch criteria in the doc (compat, perf/regression, SDKs, canary sign-off). :rocket:
